ModMetaData.name: SNLT — Labor Ledger
ModMetaData.author: pina
ModMetaData.description:
Adds two read-only stats to the info card of every producible thing: the labor embodied in it, split into the labor spent extracting raw materials and the labor spent fabricating.
Changes no gameplay. No Harmony, no assemblies, no save impact — two StatDefs and a set of XML patches.
The numbers are precomputed by solving the production graph to a fixed point from extraction outward, so a thing's labor content is the cheapest chain of real work that could produce it. Market value never enters the calculation, which is what makes the split meaningful: RimWorld prices extraction labor about fourteen times higher than fabrication labor, and this stat lets you see which side of that seam any given item sits on.
